summary: AI switched off is off everywhere, and a run never fails because the AI connection is missing.

fixes.title: AI off wins over every AI switch
fixes.text: With AI switched off for your installation, no engine, no AI summary and no tier catalog build uses AI, whatever their own switches say.

fixes.title: No failed run without an AI connection
fixes.text: When the AI summary is on but the Azure OpenAI connection is not set, the run says so once and builds the Top 50 lists without the summary.

fixes.title: Support can switch AI off
fixes.text: Support can switch the AI summary and each engine's AI switch off for your installation through the nightly update, never on.
